resources.string: Collects the technical information needed to port LibreHU to another head unit, ROM, MCU, CAN box or car, into a zip report. Read only: nothing on the unit is changed.
Looking for root (the ROM\'s own su, then the root managers)…
No root: the report is collected without it (fewer details, no partition images).
KernelSU / KernelSU Next / APatch: allow LibreHU Helper in the manager\'s Superuser list, then search again. Magisk / SuperSU: answer the prompt.
The sections to collect. The ones with root details work without it, with less.
Removes serial numbers, IMEI, Wi-Fi / Bluetooth addresses, Android ID and GPS positions from the text files.
Plug in a USB key if you want (not required), then choose the folder where the zip report is written.
This ROM has no folder picker: the report goes to the app\'s folder (Android/data/org.librehu.helper/files/diag).

Build, real Android version, properties, kernel line, partitions, mounts, services, HALs, processes, apps of the ROM maker
